gates.beats_always_long: the mean monthly difference to holding every energy always, same weights, is > 0
gates.beats_random: the mean exceeds the 95th percentile of 2,000 books with each energy's long months shuffled
gates.bootstrap: the 12-month block bootstrap's 95% interval of the mean is above 0
gates.costs_x2: mean net > 0 at twice the costs
gates.leave_one_out: mean net > 0 with any one energy left out
gates.one_month_late: mean net > 0 with the signal a month old
gates.t: monthly net t over 1985-02..2018-12 >= the threshold (every earlier test on these data; never below 3.0)
gates.top_year: no year gives more than 25% of the total net

spec.holdout_rule: registered and read only if every gate passes: 2019-01..2024-03, the same book; it passes if its mean net is > 0 and > 0 at twice the costs, with every energy present
spec.question: does holding an energy future only while contract 2 is above contract 3 earn a positive net return, and more than holding it always, at a swap-free CFD's costs?
spec.roll: one way more each month a position is held
spec.signal: 12 * ln(C2/C3) > 0 at month m-1's last priced day; long contract 2 to month m's last priced day; flat otherwise

weights.divided_by: the number of energies with data
